title: Machine learning on serum biomarkers predicts early Toxoplasma gondii infection in pregnant sheep
summary: A machine-learning classifier on 27 serum biomarkers (cytokines, acute-phase proteins) yielded a four-biomarker panel (CXCL9, CXCL10, IFN-g, SAA) with accuracy above 74% for early infection in experimentally infected pregnant sheep and 100% sensitivity in natural infection. Specificity was tested on sheep infected with Neospora or Chlamydia and the panel was checked in 19 natural abortion outbreaks. Small animal cohort (22 infected, 6 controls); abstract only; preprint.

evidence.tested: Experimentally infected sheep, sheep with other infections and 19 natural abortion outbreaks.
evidence.unknown: Human relevance; full text was not reviewed; full text not reviewed.
